'''Shrike Four''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Shrike Squadron (Saffalore)|Shrike Squadron]]. Shrike Four detected the presence of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and announced their arrival to [[Shrike Leader]].
